$comment: Child starts whose environment is not a childEnvironment(...) call at the call site (child-env-census.test.ts). Each row names how many such starts the file holds and why each is safe. 'forwarded': the env was built by childEnvironment upstream and passed through. 'owned': a fixed, caller-built env that inherits nothing broadly. A row may not hold a start that inherits process.env.

apps/server/src/services/computers/backe.reason: Lima's limactl, with the env its caller builds for the agent computer; the seam injects nothing ambient.

apps/server/src/services/core/load-gate/.reason: ps with PS_ENV: PATH and the C locale only.

apps/server/src/services/extensions/isol.reason: The extension host: buildChildEnv copies only locale and time zone, plus its own names.
A program an extension was granted: its own requested env (no loader names) plus the host PATH.

apps/server/src/services/mcp-apps/mcp-ap.reason: A stdio MCP server: the SDK's six defaults (HOME, PATH, SHELL, TERM, USER, LOGNAME) plus the env its config names.

apps/server/src/services/mesh/agent-mcp-.reason: A stdio MCP server probe: the SDK's six defaults plus the env its config names.

apps/server/src/services/rooms/repo/room.reason: Its caller passes gitEnv(), which builds on childEnvironment('git').
env is gitEnv(), which builds on childEnvironment('git').

apps/server/src/services/runtimes/claude.reason: The Agent SDK's spawn hook: the env the launch resolver built with childEnvironment('claude-code').
The shell guard: an empty env, or only ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE.

apps/server/src/services/runtimes/codex/.reason: The app-server pool: the spec's env, built by childEnvironment('codex') in acquire-codex-process.ts.
The protocol-snapshot generator: a scratch HOME and CODEX_HOME and a fixed PATH, nothing inherited.
The model probe: childEnvironment('codex', 'auth-probe') unless a test passes its own.

apps/server/src/services/runtimes/connec.reason: The default spawner, used with the command's env from childEnvironment('runtime-login', runtime).

apps/server/src/services/runtimes/openco.reason: The sidecar: buildSidecarSpawnEnv, which builds on childEnvironment('opencode').

packages/browser/src/runtime/darwin-jour.reason: A fixed PATH and the C locale.

packages/browser/src/runtime/darwin-owne.reason: The browser's own child, with the env its command names.

packages/browser/src/runtime/darwin-proc.reason: A fixed PATH and the C locale.

packages/browser/src/runtime/darwin-supe.reason: A fixed PATH, its own profile HOME and the C locale.

packages/browser/src/runtime/host-identi.reason: ps with a fixed PATH and the C locale.

packages/browser/src/runtime/installatio.reason: An installer job, with the env its caller names.

packages/cli/src/commands/community-depl.reason: dorkos community deploy's provider CLIs: the env the command builds, with the person's own provider tokens. That command loads no project .env.

packages/doe/src/builder.ts.reason: Doe's builder shell: the policy env, childEnvironment('doe') in execute-turn.ts.

packages/keep-awake/src/keep-awake.ts.reason: The default spawner, given the env option: the server passes childEnvironment('os-helper').

packages/shared/src/safe-git.ts.reason: minimalGitEnv(): twelve fixed names git needs to start, nothing of DorkOS's.
